items.title: Tony Marino interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 25, 2025
items.q: I’m going to suggest that they Google you and a fellow named Joe Wagner, guitar player?

ctx.x: into it. And he writes some beautiful stuff. So we record records and we’re going to Georgia at the end of September. And that’s about it. I mean Deer Head, a festival that they just had in Scranton, the Water Gap Festival is coming up so there’ll be a lot of musicians playing at that. So it’s small community concerts, clubs, restaurant, Deer Head Inn, you know, Lafayette Bar in Easton, you know I’ll be there Friday so you know, I’ve been busy. It’s been a decent summer and I’m happy whenever I get a gig. You…
So when folks eventually watch this video on our Fillius Jazz YouTube channel I’m going to suggest that they Google you and a fellow named Joe Wagner, guitar player?
